project.name: Proxima Milestone 9 frozen-detector temporal confirmation
project.scientific_target: A narrowband transmitter stable in the planet frame and not necessarily aimed at Earth
project.selection_rule: For each of 2021-04-29, 2021-04-30, and 2021-05-01, use the earliest complete 30-minute 2 Hz PROXCEN_S scan in the public archive and its immediately following complete 5-minute 1421-490_S control scan. Search the same 1405.25-1405.75 MHz planet-frame interval used in Milestone 8.
project.confirmation_scope: Independent in observing epoch from Milestones 7 and 8, and acquired about two years later at 2 Hz rather than 3.814697 Hz resolution; not independent in frequency because it directly retests the Milestone 8 1405.25-1405.75 MHz interval.
project.method_note: The Milestone 8 v0.4.0 recurrence statistic, S/N floor, moving per-epoch RFI mask, spectral widths, candidate clustering, family flags, orbital bank, and completeness procedure are copied without adjustment. Only the predeclared scans, one confirmation band, and random seeds differ.
project.prior_data_contact: Archive table metadata and SIGPROC headers were inspected to verify source, completeness, cadence, resolution, and coverage. No spectral payload from these six files was extracted or inspected before this preregistration.
project.control_cadence_limit: Each 30-minute ON scan is paired with the immediately following 5-minute 1421-490_S scan. OFF controls therefore have one-sixth the integration time and are less sensitive than the ON scans.
project.data_release: Breakthrough Listen Parkes P1018_2 blc05 public filterbanks

windows.selection_note: Direct temporal retest of the Milestone 8 lower confirmation interval with a 350 kHz extraction guard on each side.
